text: This chunk discusses the prevention of German measles (Rubella), emphasizing vaccination as the primary preventive measure. It outlines the vaccination schedule for children, recommending the first dose at 9-12 months and the second dose at 4-6 years. For adolescent girls and women of childbearing age who have not been vaccinated, a single dose of the MMR vaccine is advised. Women planning to conceive should get vaccinated and avoid pregnancy for at least 3 months post-vaccination. The text also provides guidelines for avoiding infection during outbreaks, such as avoiding crowded places, wearing masks, and maintaining hygiene.
